content: NAME,  I wanted to let you know personally that I appreciate your audition, it was great. We spent several days going over and over them and your talent and dedication was evident in your reading. We chose to go with a different performer based solely on personal preference of the group doing the review. I wanted to let you know that I loved your reading and didn’t  want  you  to think that us choosing to go a different way reflected in any way on your performance. I do have another book coming out this year, since the next four stories in the Shadow wars are written this one will be a  brand new  story and universe, and I would like to keep your name for when I release that one.  Reguards   Ray Bayly
